stories.title: Phone/Email Registration
stories.user_story: As a new consumer, I want to register with my phone number or email address, so that I can create an account and access personalized offers
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the registration screen, When I enter a valid UK phone number (E.164 format) or email (RFC 5322), Then the 'Continue' button becomes active
Given I enter an invalid format, When I tap 'Continue', Then an inline error appears: 'Please enter a valid phone number or email address'
Given I enter a phone/email already registered, When I tap 'Continue', Then I see 'An account with this already exists — sign in instead' with a link to login
Given I have attempted registration 5 times from this device in the past hour, When I attempt a 6th, Then I see 'Too many attempts — please try again later'
Given a screen reader is active, When navigating the registration form, Then all fields announce their label, required status, and any error messages
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) — data minimization (collect only phone/email needed for account)
stories.reasoning: Registration is the entry point. 3 points: form validation + duplicate check + rate limiting. Confidential because phone/email are PII. Security AC via rate limiting (5/device/hour).

stories.title: OTP Verification
stories.user_story: As a new consumer who has entered my phone/email, I want to verify my identity via a one-time code, so that my account is secured against unauthorized creation
acceptance_criteria: Given I have submitted a valid phone/email, When the OTP screen loads, Then a 6-digit code is sent within 10 seconds and the input field auto-focuses
Given I enter the correct OTP within 90 seconds, When I tap 'Verify', Then my account is marked as verified and I proceed to consent collection
Given 90 seconds elapse without entry, When the timer expires, Then the code is invalidated and I see 'Code expired' with a 'Resend' button
Given I enter an incorrect code, When I tap 'Verify', Then I see 'Invalid code — X attempts remaining' (max 5 attempts before 30-minute lockout)
Given I have requested 3 OTPs in 10 minutes, When I tap 'Resend', Then I see 'Too many requests — try again in 10 minutes'
stories.reasoning: OTP is a distinct user action from registration. 3 points: SMS/email delivery + timer + rate limiting + lockout. Parameters (6-digit, 90s, 3/10min) from industry security standards.

stories.title: Biometric Authentication Enrollment
stories.user_story: As a verified consumer, I want to enable Face ID or fingerprint login, so that I can access the app quickly without entering credentials each time
acceptance_criteria: Given I have completed OTP verification, When the biometric prompt screen loads, Then I see 'Enable Face ID/Touch ID for quick access' with 'Enable' and 'Skip' buttons
Given I tap 'Enable' and the OS biometric prompt succeeds, When enrollment completes, Then my refresh token is stored in the device secure enclave and future logins use biometric
Given I tap 'Skip', When I proceed, Then I can log in with email/password for future sessions and can enable biometric later in Settings
Given biometric authentication fails 3 consecutive times, When the 3rd failure occurs, Then the app falls back to PIN/password entry
Given a screen reader is active, When the biometric prompt is shown, Then the purpose and options are announced clearly
stories.reasoning: Biometric is optional but critical for mobile UX. 3 points: OS API integration + secure enclave storage + fallback. Restricted because secure enclave token grants full account access.

stories.title: Location Data Consent Collection
stories.user_story: As a new consumer completing registration, I want to understand why location access is needed and choose my tracking preference, so that I maintain control over my privacy
acceptance_criteria: Given I have completed biometric enrollment (or skipped), When the location consent screen loads, Then I see a clear explanation of why location is needed and three options: 'Always', 'Only when using app', 'Not now'
Given I select any option, When I tap 'Continue', Then my choice is recorded with timestamp and consent version, and the appropriate OS permission dialog is triggered (if 'Always' or 'App open')
Given I select 'Not now', When I proceed, Then the app functions without location-based offers (shows all offers in my city without proximity sorting)
Given a screen reader is active, When navigating consent options, Then each option's implications are announced (e.g., 'Always — receive offers even when app is closed')
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 7 — consent must be freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous
stories.reasoning: Consent must be collected before any data processing (GDPR). 3 points: consent UI + OS permission trigger + server-side consent record. Separate from transaction consent (US-010) per GDPR specificity requirement.

stories.title: Transaction Data Consent Collection
stories.user_story: As a new consumer completing registration, I want to decide whether to share my transaction data for personalized offers, so that I control what financial information the app can access
acceptance_criteria: Given I have completed location consent, When the transaction consent screen loads, Then I see an explanation of how transaction data improves offer relevance with 'Allow' and 'No thanks' options
Given I tap 'Allow', When consent is recorded, Then my choice is stored with timestamp, purpose ('offer_personalization'), and consent version
Given I tap 'No thanks', When I proceed, Then the app functions with category-preference-only matching (no transaction-based personalization)
Given either choice, When I complete registration, Then I am taken to the main app (Offers tab) and see a welcome message
Given a screen reader is active, When the transaction consent screen loads, Then the consent purpose and options are announced with their implications
Then transaction consent records are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and the consent decision is never logged with the user's financial data
stories.regulatory_linkage: GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) — consent as lawful basis for processing financial data; GDPR Art. 7 — granular consent

domain_kb_sections: kb-L2-payments-domain PD2 (Financial Information — transaction data sensitivity)

stories.reasoning: Separate from location consent per GDPR granularity requirement — users must be able to consent to each purpose independently. 2 points: simpler than location (no OS permission needed). Restricted because transaction data reveals financial behaviour.

stories.title: JWT Session Management
stories.user_story: As an authenticated consumer, I want my session to persist securely across app launches, so that I don't have to log in every time I open the app
acceptance_criteria: Given I have successfully authenticated, When a session is created, Then a JWT access token (15-min expiry) and refresh token (30-day expiry) are issued
Given my access token has expired, When I make an API request, Then the app silently refreshes using the stored refresh token and retries the request without user interruption
Given my refresh token has expired (30 days), When I open the app, Then I am redirected to the biometric/login screen
Given I log out, When the logout completes, Then all tokens for this device are invalidated server-side and removed from device storage
Then refresh tokens are stored in the device secure storage (Keychain/Keystore) and never exposed in logs or network responses beyond initial issuance
stories.reasoning: Session management is backend-heavy with security implications. 5 points: token issuance + rotation + secure storage + silent refresh + logout invalidation. Restricted because tokens grant full account access.

stories.title: Concurrent Device Session Handling
stories.user_story: As a consumer with multiple devices, I want to be logged in on my phone and tablet simultaneously, so that I can use the app on whichever device is convenient
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in on Device A, When I log in on Device B, Then both sessions remain active with independent refresh tokens
Given I log out on Device A, When I continue using Device B, Then Device B's session is unaffected
Given I change my password, When the change is confirmed, Then all sessions across all devices are invalidated and re-authentication is required
Then each device session is tracked independently with device_id, last_active timestamp, and device_name
stories.reasoning: Multi-device support is expected for consumer mobile apps. 3 points: per-device token tracking + selective invalidation + password-change global invalidation. Restricted as it involves session security.

stories.title: Registration Error Handling
stories.user_story: As a new consumer attempting to register, I want clear guidance when something goes wrong, so that I can resolve the issue and complete registration
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration API is unavailable, When I tap 'Continue', Then I see 'Something went wrong — please try again' with a retry button (not a technical error)
Given my network connection drops during registration, When the request times out after 10 seconds, Then I see 'No internet connection — check your connection and try again'
Given the OTP delivery fails (SMS provider error), When 30 seconds pass without delivery, Then I see 'Code not received? Try again or use email instead' with alternative options
Given a screen reader is active, When an error occurs, Then the error message is announced immediately via accessibility live region
Then error messages never reveal internal system details, stack traces, or whether a specific phone/email exists in the system
stories.reasoning: Error/negative path story per Rule 21. 2 points: error states for network, API, and delivery failures. User-friendly messages (no technical jargon). Accessibility live region ensures screen reader users are informed.

regression_summary.recommendation: Greenfield — no regression testing needed. All stories build new capabilities.
